title: Oops… I did it again!  And I’m so glad I did! ##OnceUponAOneMoreTime ...
transcript: So I'm always very careful about what I say about shows that I see in previews, and particularly early previews, and I think this show is a prime example of why. because when I saw the second preview of Once Upon a One More Time I'm gonna be completely honest I absolutely hated it. I thought it was really bad. I did not enjoy it. There were definitely like, moments that I really liked, certain performances that I really liked, but on the whole I did not think it was very good. But I had so many friends who saw it after me that said “Ben, you have to give it another chance, you have to go back, it's gotten so much better!” And so begrudgingly I went back and I saw the show again last night, after it's opened and after it's frozen, and I have to say I did not think I would be making this TikTok but I absolutely loved it last night in a way that I never expected to.  Like, this show is just so much fun and they have really fined tuned it. A lot of the performances that I didn't care for the first time around, I liked a lot better this time around. The writing is much more solid. Particularly in act 2, they made a lot of changes, and they all made the show better. This is still not a perfect show, I definitely still have my small gripes with it. Act one is still a little bit long, a lot of the princesses could use a little bit more development, I think some of the songs are really shoehorned in there and don't fit into the overarching narrative all that well. But it's also just like so much fun! Like those issues bothered me so much less on second viewing cause I was able to just like go in and have a good time and I think that's the key with the show. So if you were someone that saw an early preview and didn't like it or heard someone who saw it in early previews and didn't like it and that scared you off from buying a ticket give the show another chance! Because it really is so much fun, and I enjoyed it so much more than I thought I would on second watch and I'm so glad I went back!
showTitle: Once Upon a One More Time
classificationReason: Creator clearly attended the show twice (second preview and after opening), shares detailed opinions about performances, writing, and changes made to the production, with first-hand experience
